title: VINTAGE TIMBER COFFEE TABLE H-...
reason: Unmarked but well made mid-century style timber coffee table with brass screw detail; worth a look for a maker's label underneath, otherwise my estimate $60 to $120.
findings: Low rectangular coffee table with a thick timber top (teak-coloured, rounded edge profile) on four square-section legs of a darker open-grained timber (looks like oak), with long rails lapped to the outside of the legs and fixed with slotted brass screws; screw heads are visible on the apron and rails. A mid-century or Scandinavian-influenced look with a hand-finished feel. No maker's label, stamp or branding is visible and the underside is not photographed; the hanging tag is the auction's. The H-45 W-45 L-121 cm size is a title claim, and the proportions look right.
condition: Top has good colour and sheen with light surface scratches and marks, no splits or lifting seen; legs show light scuffs; all brass screws present in view; rails look sound.
rescore_note: Well made unmarked table with a teak-look top (veneer or solid, unconfirmed) on solid oak legs with exposed brass screws, in good condition for its age; no maker's label seen and the underside is not shown, so it prices as a decent unmarked mid-century table at about AU$80 to $150, more only if a Danish or known Australian label turns up (no dated sold comparables found).
